goal: By the end of the fall 2026 semester, get Tulane undergraduates to come back to Career Coach and use it every week, and learn which channel brings the students who stay.
note: This is our first day with tracker data, so there isn't enough history to show a change: 4 visitors in the last 7 days, 0 sign-ups or bookings, and 0 weekly active users. We don't know yet who the 4 visitors are, because all of them arrived today with no source tag and at least one was our own test of the site. Autumn and Mia will put the tagged links from LINKS.md in the Instagram and TikTok bios and start the daily collection rota by November 9, so that every visit has a source and we can judge each channel.

kpis.name: Site visits per week
kpis.source: Our tracker: distinct visitors with a page_view, team excluded, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv; checked weekly against Cloudflare Web Analytics
kpis.decision: A source that sends no visits for two weeks gets cut and its posting time moves to the source sending the most; if total visits fall two weeks in a row, we fix distribution before touching the product.

kpis.name: Sign-ups and bookings per week
kpis.source: Our tracker: sign_up (Get Started sent) plus booking_created events, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv; checked weekly against the team Gmail and Cal.com by hand
kpis.decision: If visits rise but sign-ups stay flat for two weeks, we change the Get Started page and the ask in our posts, not the posts' reach.

kpis.name: Activation rate
kpis.source: Our tracker: share of new visitors with resume_feedback, roadmap_built or coach_answer within 7 days of their first visit, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv
kpis.decision: Below 25% for two weeks: the home page sends new students straight into the one tool that activates best instead of showing all five.

kpis.name: Weekly active users
kpis.source: Our tracker: distinct visitors with at least one tool action (page views excluded), 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv
kpis.decision: Read with actions per active user: if users grow while actions per user fall, students are drifting away, so we pause promotion and fix the tools first.

kpis.name: Actions per active user per week
kpis.source: Our tracker: tool actions divided by weekly active users, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv
kpis.decision: Falls two weeks in a row: we pause new promotion and fix the tools students are leaving (our Peloton workouts-per-subscription number).

kpis.name: Still active after 1 week
kpis.source: Our tracker: share of each week's new users with a tool action 7 to 13 days after starting, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv
kpis.decision: Below 15%: more promotion only fills a leaky bucket, so we spend the next week fixing the product instead of posting more.

kpis.name: Still active after 4 weeks
kpis.source: Our tracker: share of each week's new users with a tool action 28 to 34 days after starting, 7 days up to each date (QUERIES.md, query D1), saved daily as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-daily.csv
kpis.decision: Decides how we spend the rest of the semester: near zero means we focus on keeping students; at or above target means we put more into the channels that bring them.
